batch_010_verified_images.shot_type: Outer Basalt Sea-Fangs & Perpetual Twilight Strait Entering the Shadow Lands (28mm)
batch_010_verified_images.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle coastal wide: jagged wet black basalt sea-fangs & creeping fog framing oil-black strait as ink-navy twilight clouds swallow bruised-amber horizon

batch_010_verified_images.shot_type: Bronze-Age Navigator Bow OTS Approaching Razor-Toothed Shadow Mountains (40mm)
batch_010_verified_images.visual_beat: 65mm ship-bow OTS: cloaked Bronze-Age navigator with brass lantern staring across dead oil-black water toward jagged Shadow Lands peaks in pallid slate-green fog

batch_010_verified_images.visual_beat: 65mm Shadow Lands gorge wide: sluggish poison-black River Ash winding between barren black shale & dead bone-pale ghost-grass stalks under toxic twilight mist

batch_010_verified_images.visual_beat: 65mm canal-level reveal matching ANCHOR-IMG0095: lone hooded figure poling black skiff between stepped greasy black stone pylons & dim crimson lanterns under twilight

batch_010_verified_images.shot_type: Stupendous Cyclopean Harbor Walls, Megalithic Water-Gate & Stepped Pyramids of Asshai (35mm)
batch_010_verified_images.visual_beat: 65mm harbor panorama: miles of battered greasy black stone sea-walls, megalithic canal gate & endless stepped pyramids dwarfing two dark-sailed Bronze-Age ships
